findings.title: merge-base is a moving proxy for the branch's cut point — an operator merge of a torn plan-apply state into their mainline, followed by task-free integ advance, would read plan-applied tasks as "inherited"; contrived, and the committed-roadmap witness covers realistic in-flight runs

the line-551 refusal still asserts "task files reach the integration branch only through 'orchid plan apply'" — untrue, with an inapplicable recovery, in the shapes `_start_tasks_inherited` deliberately declines to judge on genuinely inherited tasks (the residual of the exact wrong-premise refusal T002 fixed)
